name: bytium-core
description: Modern TypeScript framework for FiveM Enhanced with dependency injection, modules, decorator-driven handling of the FiveM runtime (commands, events, ticks, NUI, HTTP), and cross-resource communication.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bytium-core/common && npm run build -w @bytium-core/http && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.link: for dir in packages/*; do (cd "$dir" && yarn link); done
scripts.typecheck: for dir in packages/*; do if [ -f "$dir/tsconfig.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npx tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-workspace-ranges.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-workspace-ranges.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only
scripts.release:major: npm version major --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-workspace-ranges.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only
